text: On a totally free day with nothing planned, you're more drawn to:

options.label: Falling into a rabbit hole about something you're randomly curious about
Finally getting something disorganized under control

text: A friend shows you something they made and asks what you think. You find yourself noticing first:

options.label: Whether the logic or reasoning behind it actually holds up
Whether it looks and feels right

text: Which feeling do you enjoy more?

options.label: A messy pile of information finally clicking into one clear takeaway
A sentence finally saying exactly what you meant

text: Stuck waiting somewhere with nothing to do, you're more likely to:

options.label: Text someone back and forth about nothing in particular
Read or look into something you're curious about, alone

text: Which compliment would land better?

options.label: "You have a real eye for this."
"You always know how to put it into words."

text: You're handed something brand-new you've never used before. Your instinct is to:

options.label: Just start clicking around and figure it out as you go
Look for a guide or checklist first so you don't miss anything

text: Which is more satisfying?

options.label: Making something out of nothing
Solving a problem that has one right answer

text: You need to explain something important to someone. You'd rather:

options.label: Write it out carefully so it's clear on its own
Talk it through live so you can adjust as you go

text: Which would bother you more?

options.label: Something being visibly out of balance or off
Going a whole day without really talking to anyone

text: Something you rely on regularly is clunky and slow. You'd rather fix it by:

options.label: Finding or building a shortcut that speeds it up
Writing clearer instructions so it stops causing confusion

text: Which sounds more like a good week?

options.label: Everything finally running on a system that just works
You made something you're genuinely proud of

text: You're bored and scrolling. You're more likely to stop on:

options.label: A deep-dive thread or explainer about something niche
A photo or design you can't look away from

text: Which would you rather be known for?

options.label: Being sharp with numbers and reasoning
Being the person who keeps everything running smoothly

text: You're given a blank page and told to fill it however you want. You'd rather:

options.label: Make something visual or original from scratch
Write something you're proud of

text: Which is more fun to figure out?

options.label: How something new actually works, mechanically
Why a number or result doesn't look right

text: You'd rather have a day where you:

options.label: Talk to a bunch of different people
Mostly work through your own list, uninterrupted

text: Which feels more like play?

options.label: Learning everything you can about a topic just because
Making something and seeing how it turns out

text: You'd rather spend an hour:

options.label: Tinkering with settings until something works right
Adjusting colors or spacing until something looks right

text: Which would you rather be handed?

options.label: A messy paragraph that needs to be rewritten clearly
A messy schedule that needs to be untangled

text: At the end of a good day, you'd rather have:

options.label: Had a bunch of good conversations
Made something you'll want to show people
